import pathlib,hashlib,urllib.request,json
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html/saas/console')
result={}
for relative in ['assets/css/app.css','assets/js/app.js','assets/js/flow-graph.js']:
 p=root/relative
 raw=p.read_bytes();h=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
 url='https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/console/'+relative+'?v='+h[:12]
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'OnTrack-UI-Asset-Verification'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as x:live=x.read()
 result[relative]={'served':True,'size':len(raw),'sha_match':hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()==h,'cache_bust':h[:12]}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
